svg.title: framework overview
svg.desc: Three arms compare DINOv2 retrieval with ALIKED and LightGlue, the same retrieval procedure with SIFT and nearest-neighbour matching, and exhaustive SIFT matching. All lead to COLMAP mapping and evaluation of separation, pose and CPU cost. Feature counts and camera initialization/import paths differ; this is not a matcher-only ablation.

cc:Work.dc:description: Three arms compare DINOv2 retrieval with ALIKED and LightGlue, the same retrieval procedure with SIFT and nearest-neighbour matching, and exhaustive SIFT matching.
